articles.title: Indian Army Plans To Induct 450 Carl Gustaf M4 Rocket Launchers

The M4 launchers are now being manufactured at Saab's facility in Jhajjar, Haryana, while ammunition is produced domestically by Munitions India Limited, supporting India's defence manufacturing ecosystem.

articles.title: US-China SPACE WAR Begins: Beijing Unleashes New SUPER WEAPON; Trump’s Inner Circle Trembles
articles.description: China has unveiled details of a powerful new 100-gigawatt High-Power Microwave (HPM) weapon, marking one of the rare public disclosures of its advanced directed-energy capabilities. According to researchers from China's National University of Defence Technology (NUDT), the new system could generate electromagnetic pulses powerful enough to disrupt or damage electronic systems in low Earth orbit. The report suggests that China's latest HPM technology could pose a potential threat to satellite constellations such as Starlink, which have become increasingly important in modern military operations. Unlike conventional anti-satellite missiles, microwave weapons aim to disable electronics rather than physically destroy satellites, making them a potentially lower-cost option for electronic warfare.
